```python
# core.py
def word_count(text):
    # Replace contractions like "don't" with a single word
    import re
    # Replace contractions (e.g., don't, can't, won't) with a single word
    text = re.sub(r"don\\'", "don't", text)
    text = re.sub(r"can\\'", "can't", text)
    text = re.sub(r"won\\'", "won't", text)
    text = re.sub(r"n\\'", "n't", text)
    # Split the text into words and count them
    words = text.split()
    return len(words)
```
